## The 2027 catalog: café chairs, señor blue, and a 4% price rise
layout: title
subtitle: 'Prices in $ and %, "quoted" names, <angle brackets> and accents (é, ü, ñ) all print as typed.'

## All 9 desks in our 2027 catalog ship flat-packed
layout: content
subtitle: Seven changes, from part numbers to delivery terms
takeaway: Flat-pack shipping cuts delivery cost by 18% and frees 2 days of lead time

- **`C9-DESK-ELEC`** is the new part-number prefix for every electric desk in the range
- Ordering details and the full price list are in the *[2027 catalog guide](https://example.com/catalog)*
- Prices rise 4% on average; the café range (crème, olive and señor blue) stays flat
- The Müller & Söhne chair line moves to "made to order" with a 6-week lead time
- Orders < $500 ship at a flat rate, and orders > $5,000 get a 3% discount
- ***Bold italic***, **bold with *italic* inside** and `plain code` sit side by side on one line
- Ñ, ü and é sit next to 100% and 50/50 splits without breaking the line

Notes:
Source: the 2027 catalog draft of November 28 and the pricing memo of December 1.

## An order takes six steps from quote to sign-off
layout: process-6
subtitle: The 2027 order process, with what the customer sees at each step
step1: "Quote: a fixed price, the delivery week, the part list"
text1: Sales sends one fixed quote in two working days, with the delivery week and part numbers. Each price holds for 60 days, and a changed order gets a new quote within one day.
step2: "Order: signed online or on paper, at once"
text2: The customer signs online or on paper. We confirm by email in an hour, book stock against the order and resend the delivery week, so their facility team can plan around it.
step3: "Build: built, tested in our own workshops"
text3: Desks and lockers are built in our workshop, tested under load and flat-packed with the parts list inside. Every part that fails a test is replaced before the order leaves.
step4: "Ship: on the next route, in a booked slot"
text4: Orders go out on the next route. The customer gets a two-hour delivery window the day before, a text when the truck is an hour away, and the driver's name and phone number.
step5: "Fit: by our own crew; the packing is gone"
text5: Our crew fits everything on site, removes packing for recycling and leaves the floor ready for work. Our crew lead walks the floor with the customer contact before leaving.
step6: "Sign-off: on the day, with a 30-day check"
text6: The customer signs it off on the day. We call back after 30 days to fix anything that came loose, and the warranty clock starts on the sign-off date, not the delivery date.

## Four rules change in the 2027 terms
layout: bands-4
subtitle: The terms take effect on January 4 for every new order
label1: "Prices: list prices rise 4% on average from January 4, and the café range stays flat in 2027"
label2: "Delivery: orders ship flat-packed, delivery is free in the north & south on orders over $500"
label3: "Returns: unopened items come back in 30 days for a full refund; we'll collect from your site"
label4: "Warranty: desk frames carry 10 years; chairs, lockers and panels 5 years; the motors 3 years"

### text1
- List prices rise **4%** on average from January 4; the café range stays flat in 2027
- Volume discounts start at $5,000 and reach **8%** past $50,000 in one quarter
- Quotes hold their prices for 60 days, up from 30 in the 2026 terms

### text2
- Every order ships **flat-packed** unless the customer asks for a built unit, at $40 a unit
- Delivery is free in the north and south over $500, and costs $90 a drop below that
- Customers get a two-hour window the day before and a text thirty minutes out

### text3
- Unopened items come back within **30 days** for a full refund, with no restocking fee
- Built items come back only if they arrived damaged or with parts missing
- We collect returns on the next route and refund within ten days of pickup

### text4
- Desk frames carry a **ten-year** warranty, up from five years under the 2026 terms
- Chairs, lockers and sound panels carry five years; desk motors and controllers three
- Claims get a reply within one working day and an on-site fix within ten, free
